answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The island lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the mesa is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, capped per identity per epoch, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The meadow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
